title: Workspace settings — let the action follow its theme

problem.text: The action background repeats the light palette value in both themes. The existing dark palette cannot reach the button through that literal.

practices.text: Primary actions follow each theme’s palette. The two palette values remain legitimate product choices.

assumptions.text: The supplied convention for this public synthetic fixture is that primary actions follow each theme's existing palette. Preserve component dimensions, text colors and form behavior.

after.text: Use a theme-local palette alias for the action background. Keep the existing light and dark palettes, component geometry and form behavior.

architecture.title: Preserve the palette; connect the semantic role

plan.title: Connect the action role to its palette
plan.changes: Replace the two literal action-background declarations with var(--palette-blue-500, #245bdb) in their existing theme scopes.
plan.why: A palette edit should propagate to the primary action without replacing the component or changing legitimate theme choices.
plan.verification: Measure both theme colors and button dimensions; exercise keyboard form submission; retain the decision and the limits. This report records the initial assessment; completed checks are linked from the website's worked delivery.
